name: Atul Auto Limited
summary: Atul Auto Limited manufactures and sells three-wheeler automobiles in India. The company provides passenger, cargo, and e-rickshaw vehicles, as well as spare parts and accessories and auto finance. It offers its products under the Atul RIK, Atul GEM, Atul Elite, Atul:E, and Atul Shakti brands. The company also exports its products. The company has a strategic partnership with Exponent Energy Private Limited to jointly develop and deploy rapid charging electric 3-wheelers. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.
